killedBy: enemy role cues read the tank, not its kind (issues #357, #773) draws no mine block for a tank whose session took its mines away
enemy role cues read the tank, not its kind (issues #357, #773) sizes the block by the tank's own budget, so a raised cap reads wider
why: The cue would state the ROSTER's mine budget rather than this tank's. Under `?dev=1&pp1Roles=1` (issue #358) Brown, Teal and Green carry `mineCap: 0` while their roster entries read 2, so the cue would draw a mine block on a tank that cannot lay a mine -- contradicting the one thing it reports, on the very arm it would most often be run beside.
